notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We’ve prepared an update for Clink:

1. The game is now fully compatible with and supported on the Steam Deck.

2. Added a new control setting: "Inventory - I".

3. Fixed typos in texts/notes.

4. By popular request, notes are now instantly readable when picked up.

5. Fixed a bug where notes would duplicate on ladders.

6. Improved the level with the worms.

7. Enhanced some visual elements.

8. Improved certain sound effects.

9. Fixed other minor bugs.
